method: Normal-token standalone native build; normalized fault tests, actual process-local TraceLogging ETL smoke, Windows tracerpt count cross-check and real CLI refusal checks.

normalizedChecks.method: Synthetic normalized-event safety checks; not real ETL/TDH integration validation

limits: The real ETL smoke validates file consumption and TraceLogging metadata, not kernel Process/FileIo/DiskIo field mapping.
A complete target lifetime, overwrite metadata and exactly two successful owned .data flush pairs are required for the declared fresh split scenario.
Report image matching is a basename check; the caller must provide PID provenance and qualified executable identity.
Structural coverage is necessary; it is not a disk/filter/scheduler causality verdict.
